scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Freeze a literature-constrained bottom Al2O3/IGZO interface-trap-density contract and verify only the DEVSIM sheet-charge equation before any formal P2 transfer scan.
fixed_variables: channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
Poisson plus electron continuity for the coupled smoke
no bulk tail/deep traps, recombination, dynamic capture-emission, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: bulk N_tail or N_deep trap scan
dynamic trapping, hysteresis, bias-stress, or reliability claims
compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

literature_input.title: Deuterium-enabled stabilization of metal/oxide interfaces via suppressed oxygen diffusion in BEOL-compatible InGaZnO thin-film transistors
literature_input.selection_rule: Use the reported lower, intermediate, and upper values for the minimum three-point future scan; retain 4.98e12 in provenance but do not add a fourth formal device.
literature_input.source_device_context: single global bottom gate, 15 nm Al2O3, 30 nm a-IGZO, W contacts, O2 or D2 anneal
literature_input.project_mismatch: The project uses a dual gate, 30 nm physical Al2O3 on each side, 24 nm IGZO, ideal contacts, and no anneal process model; source values constrain a sensitivity range only.

interface_trap_model.unit_derivation: D_it[cm^-2 eV^-1] times a one-electron surface-energy shift numerically equal to DeltaPotential[V] gives cm^-2; multiplication by q gives C/cm^2 and dQ/dV=q*D_it gives F/cm^2.
interface_trap_model.physical_boundary_relation: At the bottom interface with +y from oxide to channel, D_channel_y-D_oxide_y=Q_it; DEVSIM therefore receives -Q_it as the fluxterm under its region0/region1 assembly convention.
limitations: This is a quasi-static linearized charge response about Psi_neutral, not a finite energy-distribution or capture-emission model.
D_it controls only the bottom interface; applying the same number to both interfaces would double count a single-interface literature value.
No bulk tail/deep states, trap-assisted recombination, time constants, hysteresis, bias stress, border traps, or temperature dependence are represented.
The literature D_it values are not project measurements or fitted parameters.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: After contract, smoke, and independent persisted-evidence checks pass, T03-P2-DIT may claim only that a literature-constrained bottom-interface D_it range and a quasi-static DEVSIM sheet-charge equation have passed zero-limit, convergence, continuity, and Gauss-law smoke tests in the frozen teaching model.
prohibited_claims: completed D_it sensitivity or completed P2 trap group
reported SS, VTH, Ioff, Ion, or mobility trend from a formal trap scan
experimental calibration, process prediction, measured project D_it, or uncertainty
dynamic capture-emission, hysteresis, bias-stress, reliability, or border-trap validation
bulk N_tail or N_deep trap evidence
both-interface trap validation or complete T03 five-group sensitivity
compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only a passed equation smoke plus independent check permits the separate minimum three-point T03-P2-DIT transfer sensitivity; P3, P5, SPICE, and layout remain closed.
